requirement_text: The organization must maintain and execute automated customer data deletion procedures within 30 days.
required_evidence_description: Data deletion procedure policy and verification logs.
evidence_text: All customer data is deleted within 30 days of receiving a verified request, and data deletion procedure verification log records are stored in the compliance audit database.
notes: Exact match with comprehensive policy and execution logs

requirement_text: The organization must implement end-to-end encryption for all customer personal data in transit and at rest.
required_evidence_description: Cryptographic architecture design and encryption key management logs.
evidence_text: All customer personal data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.3 across all production endpoints.

requirement_text: The controller must maintain a designated Data Protection Officer with direct reporting to leadership.
required_evidence_description: DPO appointment charter and organizational reporting structure.
evidence_text: The Board has formally designated the Chief Privacy Counsel as Data Protection Officer with independent reporting to the Board of Directors.

requirement_text: Organizations must conduct annual third-party penetration testing on external API gateways.
required_evidence_description: Third-party penetration testing executive summary and remediation report.
evidence_text: Independent security audit firm completed full penetration testing on external API endpoints with zero critical vulnerabilities.

requirement_text: The controller must execute Data Processing Agreements (DPA) with all third-party sub-processors.
required_evidence_description: Signed Data Processing Addenda with vendor registry.
evidence_text: Standard contractual clauses and signed DPA addenda are executed and archived for 100% of approved third-party vendors.

requirement_text: The organization must maintain documented data deletion procedures with quarterly audit logs.
required_evidence_description: Formal data deletion policy and audit logs.
evidence_text: The organization has a draft procedure and preliminary guidelines for deletion, but operational verification logs are currently partial and under development.

requirement_text: The organization must conduct mandatory annual security awareness training for all employees.
required_evidence_description: LMS training completion records and curriculum syllabus.
evidence_text: Security awareness training curriculum has been established; 68% of staff completed the training as of Q3, representing partial completion.

requirement_text: Incident response plan must be tested through an annual simulation drill.
required_evidence_description: Tabletop exercise post-mortem report and action items.
evidence_text: Draft tabletop exercise notes exist; full execution drill was partial and scheduled for completion next quarter.

requirement_text: The organization must conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA) prior to deploying biometric AI processing.
required_evidence_description: Completed DPIA signed by DPO and lead architect.
evidence_text: Discussion of theoretical artificial intelligence principles without any formal DPIA document or risk assessment for biometric systems.
notes: Topically related AI whitepaper, but DPIA is missing (False Positive Test 1)

requirement_text: The controller must maintain 24/7 automated security log monitoring with 15-minute alert triage.
required_evidence_description: SOC service level agreement and SIEM monitoring configurations.
evidence_text: Physical security guards monitor building entry turnstiles and visitor badges during regular business hours from 8 AM to 6 PM.
notes: Physical security document provided for digital SIEM monitoring obligation (False Positive Test 2)

requirement_text: The organization must maintain an offsite immutable backup with 4-hour recovery time objective (RTO).
required_evidence_description: Disaster recovery runbook and immutable cloud backup verification.
evidence_text: IT department provisions replacement laptops for employees every 36 months with standard operating system images.
notes: Hardware lifecycle policy provided for DR/backup obligation (False Positive Test 3)

requirement_text: The controller must notify data protection authorities of high-risk personal data breaches within 72 hours.
required_evidence_description: Breach notification protocol and regulatory submission templates.

requirement_text: Supervisory board must review and approve annual cybersecurity budgets.
required_evidence_description: Board minutes documenting cybersecurity budget approval.
evidence_text: The catering company agrees to provide daily lunch services for corporate headquarters staff.

requirement_text: Customer consent records must be stored with cryptographic timestamping for 5 years.
required_evidence_description: Consent management database schema and timestamping logs.
evidence_text: Marketing emails should have engaging subject lines and clear promotional branding.
notes: Marketing guidelines provided for consent record keeping

requirement_text: Access controls must enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all administrative interfaces.
required_evidence_description: IAM policy enforcing hardware/software MFA on privileged accounts.
evidence_text: All administrative console access and privileged user accounts are required to use FIDO2 or authenticator-based multi-factor authentication (MFA).
